title: Great Size!
text: Great Size!. My husband and I drink a lot of smoothies and protein shakes. We were using those large plastic Coca-Cola cups that I found on Amazon a few years ago. Most of them have cracked and we just haven't had enough cups for our drinks. These are perfect! My smoothie fits nearly to the rim, but that's okay! They look like real glass, but they do feel like plastic. They stack well. I love that they are dishwasher friendly. I am more than pleased with them.

product_metadata.title: SCANDINOVIA - 32 oz Unbreakable Premium Iced Tea Glasses Tumbler (Set of 6) - BPA Free Tritan Plastic Cups - Dishwasher Safe Drinking Glasses for Juice, Beverages, Drinks & More (Clear)
features: SPECIFICATION – 4.37 in (Top) x 2.95 in (Bottom) x 6.34 in (Height), 100% Made in Japan, Tritan (BPA Free / Prop 65 compliant) - Much better and more expensive than acrylic plastic.
QUALITY - No plastic smell, unbreakable, and reassuringly heavy - with the look and feel of glass.
UNBREAKABLE - Go ahead and drop it on the floor. We won’t tell! Type on [tritan batter up] on YouTube. You will know what we are talking about! :)
DISHWASHER SAFE - Tested in lab in Japan, over 1000 wash cycles with no cracks or hazing.

BE CREATIVE - Our customers use them as water, beer, and whiskey glasses, as well as cups for coffee! Perfect drinking glasses with melamine dinnerware. Selected as barware presents, birthday and Christmas gifts.
